preregistration: this file, committed before any generation (record-first). Source: one21labs/one21tools#328, re-measure section. Owner answers 25-Oct-2026, in-session: revision 2 'Approve as written'; domain read 'Me (owner)'.
hypothesis: Neutral (ADR 0059): appending the control-narratives revision 2 body to the system prompt may raise, lower, or leave unchanged the graded fraction of expectations met, versus the same model with no skill, on Claude Opus 5.5 and on Claude Sonnet 5.5. A null, a harmful result, or a model-dependent result are equally valid recorded outcomes.

arms.without: claude -p --model <M> --effort medium, isolation flags (--tools "", --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config, shared deny list), empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, cwd outside the checkout; hermetic_driver.NEUTRAL_FRAME + task text on stdin; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=32000
arms.with: without + --append-system-prompt = treatments/control-narratives.txt (revision 2 SKILL.md body at source_sha, frontmatter stripped)

effort: medium for both models, as 2026-10-12, so the model is the only thing that varies across the model factor.

evals.authoring: 9 tasks by a separate agent forbidden to read any repository file, given only the skill's one-line description; held out from revision 2, which was written from #328 before the tasks existed. Every task carries the expectation 'States no number absent from the task unless clearly marked unverified' (#328).
evals.domain_read: Before the prescreen, the owner strikes every expectation that rewards what the receiving engineer would reject, above all an invented setpoint or trip value (skill-measure pre-registration.md, 'Audit the expectations against the reader'). Struck expectations are recorded in strikes.json and removed from the frozen battery; nothing else is edited.

prescreen.rule: 1 bare rep per eval per model, graded BEFORE any with-arm cell. Bare fraction-met >= 0.85 = saturated -> dropped for that model only. 0.0 floors flagged, kept. Prescreen cells are never reused in the grid.
prescreen.g_floor: a model with fewer than 8 surviving evals still runs, labelled DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY (ADR 0095 decision 4)

pilot.rule: 2 with-arm cells per model on the first eval; per-model per-cell cost = mean of the pilot and prescreen cells for that model; grid refused if projected > remaining ceiling (ADR 0073)

grid: surviving evals x {with, without} x {opus, sonnet} x 2 reps; at most 9 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 72 cells
judging: Primary: grok (cross-family, `grade.py --judges grok`), which is what can promote a verdict (ADR 0093). Secondary: Claude Opus 5.5 isolated identically, FRAME-UNCHECKED. If grok cannot run, the Opus result is reported unpromoted and the README says so. Prescreen selection uses the Opus judge (selection only, no verdict).
metrics: per model: eval-clustered mean of (with - without) fraction-met, mean over reps within eval; benchstats.keep_verdict (KEEP iff 95% t-interval lower bound > 0, HARMFUL iff upper < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE; practical bar 0). Primary: the 2 per-model verdicts under the primary judge. Secondary, descriptive: the per-cell count of numbers absent from the task (the invented-value failure #328 names), per arm.
multiplicity: 2 primary intervals at 95% each, no correction.
comparison_to_2026-10-18: The 18-Oct live-text measurement's tasks and cells were lost with their branch (#328). Its numbers are context only; no delta is computed across the two instruments.

cost.estimate_basis: 2026-10-12 per-cell means: generation opus $0.063, sonnet $0.024; Opus judge $0.040 per cell. 94 generation cells plus up to 2 judges: about $10-20. #328's estimate was about $30.
